# WhiskyDB — The Canonical Structured Database for Global Fine Spirits

> WhiskyDB is a structured, provenance-tracked database of whiskies and fine spirits: bottlings with type, ABV, volume and barcode, their distilleries and producers, rule-derived cask links, and distillery-level monthly auction indices. The catalog covers 2,721 spirits and bottlings and 2,853 global distilleries, is 100% provenance-tracked, and is built from 8 integrated open data sources including Wikipedia, Open Food Facts, the US TTB COLA Registry, UK Companies House, the EU eAmbrosia GI register, and WhiskyHunter auction statistics. Coverage is uneven and documented: 545 of the 2,721 spirits have an ABV other than 40.0 (the rest show 40.0, either stated or the documented default for a source that states none), bottle volume is a documented default where the source states none (750 mL on every US label-registry record, 700 mL on the curated seed rows and on Open Food Facts records without a stated quantity), age statements are rare, and producer-published mash bills and flavor tags exist for only a handful of bottlings. It ships as downloadable SQLite and CSV snapshots (there is no hosted API), and is built for AI agents, beverage analytics, secondary auction platforms, and hospitality tech.

## Core Capabilities & Specs
- **Data Formats:** SQLite and CSV (full dataset snapshots); CSV for the free 15-record sample; Kaggle sample mirror also available as Parquet. Snapshot: 2026.09.
- **Coverage:** 2,721 spirits and bottlings · 2,853 global distilleries · 100% provenance-tracked (every bottling, producer, cask-link, mash-bill, tasting-note and price row carries a source ID into a `data_sources` provenance ledger: `primary_source_id` on spirits, `source_id` elsewhere; the sample CSVs name it in `source_name`). Includes 7,231 monthly distillery auction benchmarks (the WhiskyHunter mean winning bid per distillery and month, 60 distilleries) spanning November 2005 → September 2024, shipped as 21,228 rows: one per linked bottling per month. They are distillery-level indices, never bottle prices.
- **Data Sources (8 integrated):** US TTB COLA Registry (public domain, 17 U.S.C. § 105) · UK Companies House (Open Government Licence v3.0) · EU eAmbrosia GI Register (EU open data) · Open Food Facts / Open Drinks Facts (ODbL v1.0) · Wikipedia (CC-BY-SA 4.0) · WhiskyHunter open statistics · producer-published specifications · US labeling law 27 CFR 5.143 (public domain).
- **Attribution:** Sample data & docs — CC-BY-NC-4.0 (attribution, non-commercial). Open taxonomies in `taxonomy/` — CC-BY-4.0 (any use, including commercial, with attribution). Full dataset — commercial license; records derived from ODbL / CC-BY-SA sources retain their upstream attribution and share-alike obligations.
- **Licensing Tiers:**
  - **Public Research Sample — $0 / forever:** 15-record curated CSV sample + open cask/flavor taxonomies. Download: https://github.com/WhiskyyDB/whisky-database/tree/main/samples
  - **Standard Catalog — $49 one-time** (Stripe: https://buy.stripe.com/eVq3cw4p2afccI382s38401): full commercial catalog, SQLite + CSV, 7,231 monthly distillery auction benchmarks, full provenance ledger.
  - **Monthly refresh subscription — $49 / month** (Stripe: https://buy.stripe.com/bJeaEY6xa1IG7nJaaA38402): the same catalog, each monthly refresh auto-delivered.
  - Full pricing: https://whiskydb.dataengineered.io/#pricing-section
